planet.mapping: One year is one note. Each 0.1 °C of global warming raises the melody one step of a D minor pentatonic scale; the low drone is 0 °C, the 1951–1980 average. Strings are latitude bands, with the Arctic highest. Tempo speeds up when warming speeds up, a clashing note sounds above +1 °C, and a bell marks each new record year.
